name: Trend Kirilim Motoru v1
split: chronological hours; exclude last 168 signal hours of development and final 168 signal hours of test, independent of outcome
atr_seed: mean of first 14 true ranges; Wilder recurrence thereafter
data_history: backtest: first selected month minus 60 days per symbol; live: deployment month minus 60 days with persisted history_seed; identical signal function and indicator formulas, finite initialization origin may differ
entry: next 1h open in backtest; fresh message-time reference quote in live; validate stop and obstacle against actual entry reference
volume: base volume for trigger; USDT quote volume for universe and simultaneous-signal priority
universe: exact preceding 30 UTC days at each month start, min 60 days observed age; original futures 1d quote volumes used only for universe ranking
boundary: exclusive close_ms; 4h close at or before decision, no forming candle
obstacle: strictly between entry and target; previous 480 1h bars exclude signal bar
outcome: 1h scan; both touched uses complete 1m hour, same 1m both touched is STOP; missing 1m is STOP; adverse stop gap fills at open, target gap at target
exit_time: when resolved by 1m: terminal minute close minus 1ms; otherwise terminal hour close minus 1ms; gap: opening timestamp; slot released before next hourly entry
funding: sum actual published rates times direction sign, as percentage on fixed entry notional; not mark-price-adjusted changing notional; missing coverage conservative 0.01 percent per 8h prorated for either direction
funding_boundary: entry < funding timestamp <= exit; funding timestamps rounded down to whole seconds to remove archive calculation jitter
mfe_mae: full following 24 complete hours irrespective of earlier exit; missing bars => unverified, never zero-filled
costs: 0.30 percent of entry notional round trip; stress 0.60 percent
drawdown: closed-trade equity in R, positions all risk 1R; simultaneous exits grouped; no leverage/equity compounding; not intratrade mark-to-market drawdown
best_three: remove three largest total-net-R symbols from the selected reported subset; repeat fixed-trade-list stress, do not refill skipped capacity
outage: no fabricated bars; record errors; incomplete universe/symbol coverage prevents validated PASS
live: OFF until report approval; no order endpoints; paper only
